evals.name: unanimous-code-review-gate
evals.prompt: Run an end-to-end code review of the supplied artifact with Claude Code, zcode, and Codex Agent. Require unanimous approval, structured scores, evidence, and a final next-step plan.
evals.expected_output: All three fresh reviewers submit valid ballots for the same artifact digest and the deterministic gate emits PASSED only when every threshold is met.

evals.name: bounded-debate-on-disagreement
evals.prompt: Run the same review when one reviewer raises a material finding. Organize a bounded Ralph-style debate, re-ballot every participant, and either reach unanimous approval or produce a BLOCKED report without lowering quorum.
evals.expected_output: The first dissent produces DEBATE_REQUIRED; later rounds use immutable ballots and a debate log, and the loop stops only at PASSED or BLOCKED.
